open_questions: Public docs do not state which Asana account permission, if any, gates app creation in the developer console.

Asana documents https://mcp.asana.com/v2/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, which returned 404; the MCP challenge instead identifies the working https://mcp.asana.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/v2 endpoint.

blockers.problem: The opening sends the reader directly to the developer console before presenting the main-app navigation path as the next sequential route.
blockers.suggestion: Change the opening to “Sign in to Asana,” then retain the direct developer-console URL as an alternative after the documented profile-photo navigation path.

nits.problem: The guide opens the direct developer-console URL and then instructs the reader to navigate there from Asana's main app.
nits.suggestion: Start at Asana's main app for the numbered navigation, or tell readers who use the direct URL to continue at Create the MCP app.

history.revision_notes: Updated external.md to begin with “Sign in to Asana.” The numbered steps now follow the documented main-app navigation, with the direct developer-console URL retained afterward as an alternative. This resolves both the blocker and nit.

research_change.notes: Catalog presence is now confirmed for Asana. This requires re-drafting speakeasy.md from conditional catalog/custom paths to the catalog-only add-server path and adds PulseMCP provenance in meta.yaml.
